title: Rigatoni with tomato & garlic
summary: Simple weeknight pasta, great for testing the auto pasta timer.
source: Starter outline written by Claude. Matthew: replace/compare with a TheMealDB import, then hand-check.

steps.instruction: Bring a big pot of water to a rolling boil and salt it well.
looks_right: lots of bubbles breaking the surface all over
looks_wrong: only small bubbles at the bottom (not boiling yet)

steps.instruction: Add the rigatoni and stir straight away so it doesn't stick.
looks_right: pasta moving freely in the water
steps.done_when: Pasta is in and stirred. Start the timer as soon as it goes in.

steps.instruction: Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a pan on medium-low and gently cook the garlic.
steps.done_when: Garlic is pale golden, about 1–2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add the tomatoes and chilli, simmer while the pasta cooks.
looks_wrong: sauce sticking or catching on the bottom

steps.instruction: Taste a piece of pasta. It should be al dente. Save a mug of pasta water, then drain.
looks_right: firm bite with no white core
looks_wrong: pasta swollen, splitting or falling apart (overcooked)
steps.done_when: Bite test: tender with a slight firm centre. Ask the cook to hold a piece up to the camera or bite it.

steps.instruction: Toss the pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water, then add basil and parmesan.
